description: The Mourtzinos, or Troupakis, complex in old Kardamyli is a three-storey stone tower house beside the domed family church of Agios Spyridon, with cypresses and the Taygetos slopes behind. The morning is partly cloudy, cloud cover about 65 percent, about 21.6°C, and dry. Vathia is a different Mani village.
